description: This Java source file defines the CustomerOptionsSetController class, which manages CRUD operations and user interactions related to customer option sets within an admin interface for an e-commerce platform. It handles requests for listing, saving, deleting, and updating customer option sets, integrating with various services and managing UI-related data.

classes.name: CustomerOptionsSetController
classes.description: Controller managing Customer Option Sets, including listing, saving, deleting, and updating customer option sets.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the list of customer option sets along with available options and values.

methods.name: saveOptionSet
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new CustomerOptionSet, validating inputs, checking for existing associations, and persisting the new set.

methods.name: pageOptionsSet
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to paginate and list customer option sets in JSON format.

methods.name: deleteOptionSet
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to delete a specific customer option set by ID, with authorization checks.

methods.name: updateOrder
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to update the display order of a customer option set.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the active menu items for the UI context.
